description: Flights, trains, cars, buses, ferries, walks, and other point-to-point travel. Use provider_reservation_code for provider-issued reservation, confirmation, or booking codes. MCP clients displaying transportation dates/times must convert UTC departure_at with departure_timezone and UTC arrival_at with arrival_timezone. Supports common list filters. Supported transportation_type slugs: airplane, bike, bus, car, roadtrip, cruise, ferry, motorcycle, subway, train, transfer, walk. Labels: airplane = Flight; bike = Bike; bus = Bus; car = Car Rental; roadtrip = Drive / Road Trip; cruise = Cruise; ferry = Ferry; motorcycle = Motorcycle; subway = Subway; train = Train; transfer = Transfer; walk = Walk. Use only these exact slugs; custom categories are not supported for transportations. Safety: Closed-world: operates within the authenticated user's Tripsy account and accessible trips.
